🔥 nyetdb | Rust
🎯 Primary Use Case: To enable AI agents to safely query databases without the risk of accidental data modification or unauthorized access, by providing a secure, read-only interface.
✨ Key Features: • Read-only access across multiple database types • Layered security: AST validation, session modes, read-only roles • Project-scoped connections based on directory access • Password management, keeping credentials out of agent reach
📖 Summary: NyetDB is a Rust-based CLI tool designed to provide AI agents with secure, read-only access to various databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, MongoDB, ClickHouse, Redis). It acts as a secure gateway, preventing unauthorized write operations and protecting sensitive data through multiple layers of security and logging.
